_comment: DEEP variant of lisennet_conv_hardened_nc24: n_blocks 3 + inter_dilations [1,2,4,8,16] -> 46,248 params, temporal RF 196 frames (3.14s, ~3x the nc24 b2 baseline's 68) — attacks the residual conv-vs-GRU gap (bounded temporal memory) identified in the hardened study (nc24 b2: FP32 3.013 / int8 rt 2.998). Same NPU-safe ops; windowed deploy window grows to 196+emit_T. Depth chosen over width because nc28 (wider) trained WORSE than nc24 — capacity was non-monotonic in width; depth is the untested axis. Retrain into cp_lisennet_conv_hardened_nc24_deep.
